notes.title: Security Hole update - 18 April 2017 (1.1.19) - unlimited boosters mode
notes.content:
In this update you will find the unlimited boosters mode that will allow you to overcome almost any obstacle. But if you worry about your world rankings, you must ensure that you use the right amount of boosters within the limit.

Also you will find an assortment of minor bug fixes and improvements.

notes.content:

- Improved survival mode: now it's more difficult on later iterations and has a new leaderboard 
- Now you can skip the story by pressing the X (close) button while in the chat
- Improved experience in the offline mode
- Assortment of UI fixes
- Minor figure control fixes
- Fixed cloud sync
- Improved 6 illustrations

notes.title: Security Hole update - 04 October 2016 (1.0.1)
notes.content:
This update includes: 
- Major leaderboard fixes. Now you will see yourself in the rankings even if you are not in the top 20.
- Added gamepad hints throughout the whole UI
- Added color indication for the levels passed without boosters at least once
- Changed conditions for the "Game master" and "Hardcore gamer" achievements - now it is required to pass the relevant level without boosters at least once
- Now the camera can be centered with the 'C' key or the 'A' gamepad button
- Minor Dutch localization fixes (thanks to Jean Fraude van Damme)

notes.title: Security Hole released - 28 September 2016 (1.0)
notes.content:
Here is the prequel to the main story of Security Hole: https://youtu.be/HOoVZ866_Io

This update includes:
- The reworked soundtrack with new themes. All of these tracks are adapting dynamically to the current tension in the game.
- Three illustrations added
- Now you can open the overall and the map leaderboards using the left bumper or the 'O' key
- Now you can open the current level leaderboard using the right bumper or the 'L' key
- Now you can use WASD keys for the menu navigation
- The Exit button added on the welcome screen

notes.title: Security Hole update - 26 September 2016 (0.9.28b)
notes.content:
In this update you will find the following types of leaderboards:
- Overall leaderboard contains the sum of best scores on each passed level
- Map leaderboard contains the sum of best scores on each passed level on this specific map
- Boss leaderboard is dedicated to a specific boss level
- Survival leaderboard is dedicated solely for the survival level (S1)
- Simple local leaderboard for all other levels

notes.title: Security Hole update - 20 September 2016 (0.9.26b)
notes.content:
This is an important update because it will wipe all your previous progress!

What's new:
- Steam Cloud support. Your progress will start all over!
- Steam Achievement fixes. There is something to improve though. 
- Chat history access: now you will be able view all chat dialogs.
- Added Japanese and Traditional Chinese localizations.
- Added 2 illustrations and updated a dozen of other illustrations.
- Added a cool special effect to the final dialog ːsteammockingː
